clauses.quote: The Supervisor shall use three (3) of the 30-minute morning blocks (90 minutes), if there is a need to achieve one (1) additional individual planning period for the Teacher.
All planning periods provided through the use of the 30-minute morning blocks shall be at least 30 minutes in duration

clauses.quote: All secondary school teachers shall be given at least five (5) daily planning periods per week that are equal in length to a class period, except as may be mutually agreed between the Supervisor and the Teacher.
clauses.notes: "given" indicates an entitlement granted by management.

clauses.quote: The planning periods shall be scheduled during the normal workday, as defined in this Agreement.
